mLocKeys.keyTooltip: This unit has been marked by Locke's artifact.
Locke is ready to throw his Soul Nails.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Locke's attacks deal additional magic damage On-Hit, increased based on enemy missing Health.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Locke's Attacks deal an additional <magicDamage>@MinOnHitDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> on-hit, increased up to <magicDamage>@MaxOnHitDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> based on the target's missing Health.
Locke has sealed champions in his artifact, increasing its power.
This unit is marked by Soul Nails.
This unit is marked by Soul Nails.

Locke teleports to a location, dealing @OnHitDamage@ magic damage to nearby enemies on arrival.

On his next Attack, he dashes to his target, dealing @DashDamage@ magic damage to all enemies in his path. Each hit consumes Soul Nails.

If Locke scores a takedown, the Cooldown of this Ability is reset.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Locke teleports to a location before dashing to attack his next target, dealing damage to enemies passed through.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Locke teleports to a location, dealing @OnHitDamage@ magic damage to nearby enemies on arrival.

On his next Attack, he dashes to his target, dealing @DashDamage@ magic damage to all enemies in his path. Each hit consumes Soul Nails.

If Locke scores a takedown, the Cooldown of this Ability is reset.
This unit is marked by Soul Nails.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Locke readies a set of Soul Nails to throw, dealing damage to and marking enemies hit. Locke can consume the marks to deal bonus damage with his attacks.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Locke readies a set of Soul Nails to throw, dealing @MissileDamage@ magic damage and marking enemies hit. Nails apply a @SlowAmount1*100@/@SlowAmount2*100@/@SlowAmount3*100@% Slow for @SlowDuration1@/@SlowDuration2@/@SlowDuration3@ seconds, stacking with the amount of nails hit.

Attacking the enemy consumes the Soul Nails, dealing @NailDamage@ magic damage per stack, increased by @TwoMarkBonusPercent@% and @ThreeMarkBonusPercent@% for two and three nails respectively.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Each remaining nail refunds @AmmoCooldownReset@ of Ability's Cooldown and Mana cost when this effect ends.</rules>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Locke throws a binding artifact that deals damage and potentially executes enemies hit. Locke gains additional power for sealing away enemy champions.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Locke throws a binding artifact to a location, dealing @Damage@ magic damage and Slowing enemies in the area by @SlowAmount*100@%, decaying over @SlowDuration@ seconds. The artifact marks enemies hit for @Duration@ seconds, sealing away marked enemy champions brought below @ExecuteTooltipCalc@, and resetting the duration of the mark on other affected champions.

After the duration ends, if at least one champion was sealed, the artifact lands on the ground. Locke can pick up the artifact to permanently increase its execution threshold by @ExecuteThresholdPerStack*100@%, and refund @CooldownReduction@% of his total Cooldown, for each champion sealed.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>The artifact will linger on the ground for this Ability's current Cooldown at the time of sealing.</rules>

mLocKeys.keyCost: @Cost@ Mana and <font color='#CC3300'>@HealthCost*100@% Current Health</font> Per Second
mLocKeys.keySummary: Locke ignites his soul, gaining Attack Speed and Move Speed, and dealing damage to himself. At the end of the duration, Locke will heal back a portion of the damage he takes during the effect.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Locke ignites his own soul, gaining @AttackSpeed@ Attack Speed and @MoveSpeed@ Move Speed that decays over @DecayTimeHelper@ seconds.

For @BaseDuration@ seconds, he suffers @HealthCost*100@% current Health true damage per second but Heals back the last @DamageRestoreAmount@ damage taken, and an additional @AdditionalHeal@ Health based on missing Health and time passed, up to a maximum of @MaxHealingThreshold@ Health remaining.

Can be Recast to end early.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
This Ability can be used while Disabled.
Locke is Ghosted for the duration. {{Reminder_Ghosted}}
